summary: Queue Oracle Thick-mode image publication from an approved release.
userImpact: Release maintainers can include the Oracle image in the release dispatch and track its qualification and publication from the release run.
configuration: Set publish_oracle_image=true on an approved Release Please publication dispatch when the release requires Oracle Thick mode.
security: Oracle qualification, scans, signatures, and receipt verification remain required for the exact released source.

customerDocumentation.reason: This changes the maintainer's release workflow and preserves the image and runtime contracts.

knownLimitations: Oracle image availability follows the Oracle publisher and its signed receipt.
rollback: Use the standalone Oracle publisher for an approved historical release.
validation: Exercise the opt-in boundary, exact release dispatch, duplicate suppression, and retained qualification recovery.
